cells.tense: The joy is here now, and your hands are on its shape.
cells.act: bring the two sides of your thinking into one plan
cells.ask: Settle tonight what one gathering you're part of is actually for and when it happens — two lines, decided before you poll the room.
cells.core:
You can hold a room and still be in it. Good feeling shows up among people you know, and you give it a frame — a time, a place, a reason to come — and the frame doesn't flatten the feeling. It's what lets it reach the far end of the table. Your thinking about it holds two things at once: what the others need and what you actually want. That's the integration. Neither side has to give way.

There's something you keep half-organizing and haven't settled. Decide it this week: what it's for, when it happens. Two lines, no committee. The plan stays yours to make and change. Settling it doesn't use up the pleasure of it — that part is worth keeping.
cells.sheetLine: You can give a good thing a shape and still be in it.
cells.verb: Making joy something a group can count on
cells.place: Where the form of a thing gets built

cells.tense: You'll have the next gathering built before anyone has said they want it.
cells.act: return to the work daily until it is profound
cells.ask: Choose something you keep rebuilding — a dinner, a standing call, something you make for people — and do today's part of it, then stop, whether or not anyone asked.
cells.core:
Joy is turning into something you produce ahead of time. You're building the occasion before anyone wants it, and organizing the feeling gets harder to tell apart from having it. Whatever's being planned is getting planned further out than the people arriving to it.

Go back to the thing itself, daily. One piece a day, no more, whether or not anyone asked. Work on the version that already exists — that one, not the one still coming. If it's worth building it'll still be worth building when you're not bracing; if it isn't, you'll find that out by doing it rather than by carrying it.
cells.sheetLine: The occasion gets planned further out than the people have arrived.
cells.verb: Making joy something a group can count on

cells.tense: It has been a while since you said yes to something you didn't set up.
cells.act: follow the thought past where it is comfortable
cells.ask: Pick something you enjoy and keep going ten more minutes after you'd normally check your phone or start tidying, adding nothing to it.
cells.core:
You are behind a door you already walked through. Shared occasions are the kind you arrange yourself, and the part missing is being carried along by a crowd. The organizing is steady. What you're in isn't bigger than you any more. Going well here would look like a night where another person decided the shape and you just showed up for it.

Stay with one pleasant thing longer than it's useful. Ten more minutes, no arranging, no improving, no checking. Let it be a thing you're doing rather than a thing you're running. Joy returns through the ordinary senses first — the hands catch up later.
cells.sheetLine: You arrange the occasions alone and nobody carries you along.
cells.verb: Making joy something a group can count on

cells.tense: The plans are working and you are calling them circumstance.
cells.act: sort the pieces into a shape you can act on
cells.ask: Before the next get-together you attend, name silently the single move you're already planning to make — the introduction, the topic, the moment you'll leave — then walk in and do it.
cells.core:
You keep the good things working — you notice who's uncomfortable, you set the pace, you end the night before it sours — and you'd say it just turned out that way. The calls are real and they're good. What's missing is your part in making them. You file it under how the room was.

Look at the next gathering before you walk in. Name silently the one move you're already going to make — the introduction, the thing you'll bring up, the moment you'll leave. Then go do it. You shape the evening; this lets you see your own hand in it while it's still yours to change.
